Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.footer

package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.footer
The classes that decode the footer of a Parquet file. They are written against the Parquet format specification and only use the Java runtime.
